parsed.explanation: Combined regime pairs life-imprisonment same-sex criminalisation and documented police use of that law—2018 witch hunt with forced anal examinations and torture, a committee to identify and punish homosexuals, custody abuse—with June 2024 horrific beating of a trans activist and escalating anti-LGBTI weaponisation. No traveller-facing protective remedy is shown to operate and access to justice is poor. No trans-specific entry, facility or custody rule is documented, so this is not a tier-1 universal-exposure case, but state-directed targeting and thin recourse place it in High Risk.

entry_documents.exposure: No trans-specific passport, marker or border-screening rule is documented. General criminalisation could be invoked if documents, presentation or a partner prompt scrutiny.
entry_documents.interaction: No documented border practice for foreign trans documents; any document discrepancy could interact with police investigation under morality provisions.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented 2013 police custody torture and 2018 forced anal examinations during a crackdown; mainland same-sex offence carries life imprisonment, gross indecency 1-5 years.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No visitor custody placement, consular access or remedy is shown to operate.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Document or presentation mismatch could lead to arrest, custody abuse and prosecution; semi-autonomous jurisdiction adds separate penalties, including up to five years for sex between women.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No bathroom, ward, shelter or other facility-access law for trans visitors is documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Absence of documented facility rules does not offset documented police targeting; hospital or detention placement if outed is unknown.

care_services.exposure: Documented discrimination limits rights enjoyment; 2017 deportation of HIV/AIDS staff for promoting homosexuality disrupted services. No trans-specific visitor care denial is documented.
care_services.protection: 2010, 2013 and 2017 nursing, midwifery and family-planning texts commit to non-discriminatory care, but enforcement against documented discrimination is not established.
care_services.interaction: Paper non-discrimination language may not protect an outed visitor from refusal, outing or police referral in practice.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Weaponisation of law against LGBTI people, government website blocking, declining speech and assembly respect, and a 2018 official committee to identify and punish homosexuals document state threat-framing.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Media ethics text bars sexual-orientation hate speech, but present enforcement and any trans-specific protection are not documented; 2020 online hate-speech ban was repealed.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hostile framing increases outing and police leverage; paper media protections do not neutralise criminalisation or documented crackdowns.

minors_guardians.exposure: No traveller-with-minor rule is documented. Semi-autonomous decree sets age thresholds below 12 and under-18/marriage distinctions; no relationship recognition or joint adoption for same-sex couples.
minors_guardians.protection: Not documented for travelling families or minors.
minors_guardians.interaction: A minor does not create a documented additional traveller exposure, but family-planning counselling language is age-inclusive on paper without established enforcement.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: June 2024 trans activist abducted by 12 men, beaten in forest, ears cut; activists report substantial prejudice, violence and transphobia. No prosecution or effective police response is documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: UN condemnation and constitutional equality flagging are documented, but no operative local protection or conviction is shown.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Private violence is amplified by poor access to justice and documented security-force excessive force; police may worsen rather than remedy incidents.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Lack of access to justice, fear of reprisals for defenders, and unsafe complaint conditions degrade recourse. Post-2024 trans-specific incidence and current enforcement frequency are not documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: No functioning hate-crime, compensation or visitor remedy is documented as operating.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unknown current frequency does not resolve toward safety; structural web of criminalisation, targeting and impunity extrapolates toward risk.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than this case on routine documented arrest and custodial beatings for presentation, but similar in life-imprisonment exposure, illusory recourse and impunity; this dossier lacks a credible capital pathway.

Very similar: extortion and short detention under vague morality laws with dismissed complaints. This case is slightly worse because penalties reach life imprisonment and torture/forced examinations are documented.

Higher risk than this case: police stops there usually end in release or fines, whereas here documented crackdowns involved torture, forced examinations and a 2024 severe trans-specific beating without shown remedy.

parsed.synthesis: The operative interaction is document/presentation outing or association being used through morality law by police and officials, leading to detention, forced examinations or abuse, while private violence faces poor justice. Paper healthcare and media protections are not shown to operate and cannot offset documented targeting. No universal facility or border regime is documented, keeping the case above the 0.15 tier, but organised state-tolerated targeting, life-imprisonment exposure and thin recourse keep it near 0.25.
